minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  April 20, 2021

  The Successor Agency of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
  Tuesday, April 20, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Council Member Morales
  announced the call-in instructions for public comments.

  Mayor Butts left the dais at 2:04 p.m.

  Mayor Butts returned to the dais at 2:05 p.m.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
  item on the Agendas.

  Wanda York called and asked if she could comment on the citywide parking.

  Mayor Butts encouraged the caller to wait toward the ending of the City Council Meeting
  to address her concerns during open public comments.

  Mayor Butts called the City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and
  Housing Authority at the hour of 2:09 p.m.

  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
  presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales, and Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.

  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
  follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority.

  142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Morales, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Padilla that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated April
  15, 2021, in the amount of $2,160,316.67 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority is hereby authorized to certify
  upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

183  AMENDMENT NO. 3 TO AGREEMENT NO. 16-016 APPROVED – PSOMAS:
  RESOLUTION NO. 21-82 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2020-
  2021 CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM (CIP) BUDGET. Staff report dated
  April 20 2021, was presented recommending approval of Amendment No. 3 to

  1
 April 20, 2021

  Agreement No. 16-016 (Agreement) with PSOMAS (Consultant) extending the term of
  the Agreement for five (5) additional months and increasing the compensation in an
  additional amount of $59,824 (new total contract amount not to exceed $5,313,512).

  It was moved by Council/Successor Agency Member Morales, and seconded by
  Council/Successor Agency Member Faulk that the City Council/Successor Agency does
  hereby: 1) Approve Amendment No. 3 to Agreement No. 16-016; and 2) Adopt
  Resolution No. 21-82 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD AMENDING THE 2020-2021, ANNUAL BUDGET TO
  PROVIDE  FUNDING  FOR  CONSTRUCTION  CONTRACT
  ADMINISTRATION THROUGH PROJECT CLOSE-OUT AND TO ASSIST
  THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT WITH RESOLVING ANY
  POTENTIAL CONSTRUCTION CLAIMS AND DISPUTES.

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk,
  and Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  MINUTES. It was moved by Successor Agency Member Morales, and seconded by
  Successor Agency Member Padilla that the Minutes for the Successor Agency Meetings
  held on August 25, 2020, and September 1, 2020, be approved. The motion was carried
  by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Successor Agency Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Successor Agency
  Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Abstain: Successor Agency Member Faulk.

  There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in the honor of Sargent Juan Ferreira at the hour of 2:19 p.m.

  Approved this 24th day of August, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Chairman
